## History

Pendexter was one of the unexpected guests who arrived with [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) at Anne's house. During the visit, the guests were treated to a delightful dinner provided with Diana's help and enjoyed a pleasant walk through the woods before taking their leave.

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_
